chapters.title: Liturgy · API enforcement
chapters.text: This technical demonstration follows real requests to the local Liturgy API. The display shows selected response fields, while authentication credentials remain outside the recording.

captions.text: This technical demonstration follows real requests to the local Liturgy API.

chapters.title: Read the workspace
chapters.text: An authenticated request has returned the seeded projects. We select Lantern and inspect its actual board and movement state, using a fresh database for this demonstration.

captions.text: An authenticated request has returned the seeded projects.

chapters.title: Inspect the loop
chapters.text: Lantern twenty four has three movements recorded and cannot yet be marked done. The response exposes both the next movement and whether completion is currently allowed.

captions.text: Lantern twenty four has three movements recorded and cannot yet be marked done.

chapters.title: An incomplete loop is rejected
chapters.text: A premature Done request returned conflict, with the explanation that the five R loop is incomplete. This is server enforcement, independent of the disabled button in the browser.

captions.text: A premature Done request returned conflict, with the explanation that the five R loop is incomplete.

chapters.title: Record Render
chapters.text: The Render request succeeded. The response now reports four completed movements and Rejoice as the next step. The artifact and change notes accompany the movement.

captions.text: The Render request succeeded.

chapters.title: Record Rejoice
chapters.text: The thanksgiving request succeeded. All five movements are logged, and the API now reports that this card can be marked done.

chapters.title: Complete and read back
chapters.text: The Done request succeeded, and a fresh board request confirms the card remains in Done. This read back verifies the saved result rather than relying only on the command response.

captions.text: The Done request succeeded, and a fresh board request confirms the card remains in Done.

chapters.title: Inspect the gate checklist
chapters.text: The project response shows the Develop gate is blocked by its outstanding demo preparation requirement. The checklist is a recorded team declaration, not an automated assessment of every artifact.

captions.text: The project response shows the Develop gate is blocked by its outstanding demo preparation requirement.

chapters.title: Save and verify the gate
chapters.text: The checklist update succeeded, and another project request confirms the gate is Open. The response gives clients the same persisted gate state.

captions.text: The checklist update succeeded, and another project request confirms the gate is Open.

chapters.title: Shared rules, faithful practice
chapters.text: The API has demonstrated movement ordering, completion enforcement, and a persisted gate update. These shared rules support a team rhythm of prayer, discernment, action, and gratitude.
